                                         ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 19-H in the area bounded by:
       A line 44.00 feet south of and parallel to West Chase Avenue; a line 100.00 feet east of
       and parallel to North Damen Avenue; a line 73.00 feet south of and parallel to West
       Chase Avenue; and North Damen Avenue.

to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
